contributionMap.claim: Method: identify the complete linear Darboux set with the graphic arrangement (cycle matroid) of the cone over the tree, and use triangle/cofactor conditions (Lemma 3.5) and Whitney's line-graph theorem to recover the tree from any LV coordinate presentation

contributionMap.closestPriorWork: Graph recovery from cone matroids via triangles (Proudfoot-Ramos 2019, Remark 1.1) and Whitney's theorems are classical and credited; arrangement-theoretic language for Lotka-Volterra Darboux sets was not found in the bounded search

contributionMap.claim: Complete linear Darboux list of tree systems with an exact (necessary and sufficient) genericity condition Delta_T != 0, and the codimension-one strata (Theorem 2.3, Proposition 2.5)
